description.zh: 新的展示名称，最长32个字符
description.en: The new display name. The maximum length is 32 characters.

description.zh: 新增属性定义，新增属性必须为可选属性
description.en: The new attribute definitions. New attributes must be optional.

description.zh: 更新已有属性定义，仅支持修改展示名称、描述以及ENUM追加枚举值
description.en: The updates to existing attribute definitions. You can modify only the display name and description. You can also add enumerated values for attributes of the ENUM type.

descriptions.zh: 需要购买 DataWorks 专业版及以上版本才能使用。
descriptions.en: This operation requires DataWorks Professional Edition or a later version.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dataworks-public update-meta-entity-def --entity-type custom_entity-customer_api --display-name Business_API --description description --new-attribute-defs '["example-string"]' --update-attribute-defs '["example-string"]' --api-version 2024-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dataworks-public UpdateMetaEntityDef --region cn-hangzhou --EntityType 'custom_entity-customer_api' --Description description --DisplayName Business_API --NewAttributeDefs '["example-string"]' --UpdateAttributeDefs '["example-string"]'
